summary: The proposal is well structured and satisfies the core completeness requirements: it contains the required sections, detailed action-oriented objectives, a sufficient peer-reviewed bibliography, three referenced UML figures, a measurable iterative schedule, and a specific AI transparency statement. The main improvement is stylistic: the proposal relies repeatedly on first-person formulations outside the transparency statement and should use explicit system or stakeholder subjects instead.

findings.title: Reduce Repeated First-Person Formulations
findings.description: The proposal repeatedly uses first-person formulations outside the required AI transparency statement, although the guidelines recommend avoiding “I” and instead using explicit system or actor subjects. Replace these formulations with active, impersonal alternatives where possible, such as “The platform provides...” or “The evaluation measures...”.

locations.quote: In this thesis, **I develop** a self-service platform on which every grant carries an expiry date from the moment somebody requests it.
